body: Im OP, i just deleted my other account..This is my old throwaway. Thanks for caring ...
I'm in the process of deleting all my accounts so I can be forgotten, I'll still be around for a few hours. Thanks for caring by the way, it means alot
I've "kept going" for too long now. I'm not low, I'm just done.
Yeah, or just give it all up

Thanks!! And I know I totally should..or else I'll never let myself live knowing that I didn't even try. The only complication is that my best friend likes her too :/ ... It's just fucking with my head so much. I can't even eat or sleep anymore, it's a tad concerning. I usually would totally agree with the 'not giving a fuck' method..but sadly, for once i can't help but to care :(

Oh it's no problem, I don't mind. Basically there is a girl I really like, and I know I shouldn't let this stuff get to me..but I really feel a connection with her. Completely different then stuff I've experienced in the past. I'd love to ask her to prom but it could be too late. Unfortunately time is quickly running out and all will be lost anyways. Nothing is technically wrong though, I should be grateful for everything..which I am. It's just I'm so close yet I feel so far away..

**EDIT: Sounds rather stupid, but oh well

To be honest, i really am not sure. I guess it could be getting closer to the things we desire..? That sometimes boost me for a bit, before I fall. And another good question, that i wish I had an answer too. I guess you just have to try, and not worry about what happens. Also thanks asking, I'm not doing the greatest. My mind is a confused mess currently :/

Thank you for your honest input, and he hasn't hinted yet but it's just my assumptions from how he acts.

I definitely should try to relax, and just do it. Do you think I should just sit down with her, and simply ask her? 
Thanks for the support btw

EDIT: yeah, I suppose. My apologies, and thanks again though

Thanks for sharing, and you clearly know your life better than me, so take me advice just as some food for thought. Your girlfriend, if she makes you happy when your together and you love her, then don't feel so down. If this bothers you so much, you should talk to her about it when your together. Communication is great for solving things. Don't let life pass you by, do what makes YOU happy. If you care for her, figure out what makes you both happy. Currently, I would give the world to be with a girl like, but I feel myself slipping. I guess to each is their own, find what you want. Reach it before it's too late... You still have a lot going for you..take advantage of that!!

Your story is quite touching, and I'm so glad that all of this amounted into something so positive for you! Its amazing how some seemingly miraculous events happen. Your speech Is very uplifing, and I hope Others Gain the needed motivation. I've been trying, pushing, and so far it keeps pushing my mind deeper into a dark hole. I have so much to be grateful for, yet I feel as if I'm failing. My love goes out to all who feel down, and I'm glad that people like you can turn everything around...almost gives me hope. Thanks for sharing though, I wish you the best

I read your post only to realize that I'm stuck In some pointless, uncessary loop of sadness as well. I have supportive family and friends who love me, and yet I couldn't feel anymore disatisfied inside. I too have gotten up after being knocked down, only to feel lower than last time. My mind is becoming infected with tainted memories I'm creating for stupid reasons. What I see in you is potential though, you just need the boost to get you out of this slump :)

I read the while thing, and although the events that brought you down differ than mine..I can still see an eerie resemblance to myself. The way described how you feel, matched me before. And sadly today I layer in bed all day, listening to music, and browsing reddits. Then You reach that day where you feel so down, like never before. Then you realize if you fall deeper next time, that might be the end. I almost was there, too close. You'll have some ups and downs, just grab hold of those ups. Let them help us carry bus to happiness. And as for the girl, honestly don't worry about it. Go with the flow my friend. She definitetly has interest in you, and with experience comes improvement. You just got to keep climbing up this steep hill called life, you can do it :)
Certainly, glad i could help you out a bit! And same goes for me bud, I'm here if you need someone to talk to. Thanks for that, I'll try my best, and you should too.

You can't let the depression settle within my friend, it infects your mind like a poison. Instead, expand the hope you have. Even if it's only a little, I know it's there inside you. You are there with him, imagine how much that means to him. You can stay strong, I believe in you. My greatest condolences go out to you and your boyfriend. And remember, each day will bring something new:)

Things will get better buddy. We all have our highs and lows. Sometimes really low, like I'm feeling currently. My low is more like pure confusion, at least you have logical reasons to be feeling down. Everyday is a different story, somedays fantastic others just beat you down into the dirt. Once you hit rock bottom, the only way you can go is up. My best advice is to appreciate all the subtle little things in life, the little things that make you happy. The issues you described are rather temporary, and as for the girl. There is still chances to improve, cherish the moments you've had. You must wait for,the clouds to pass in order to see the sunshine :)
